name: docker
label: Docker
description: Docker is a platform for developing, deploying, and managing applications using containers. This connector enables you to manage Docker containers, images, networks, and volumes, as well as retrieve system information and monitor Docker resources.

fields.title: Authentication Type
fields.description: Specifies the authentication method used by the connector to establish a connection with the Docker Engine API.
fields.tooltip: Select the authentication method supported by the Docker Engine server. Currently, certificate-based authentication is supported for secure TLS connections.
fields.name: authentication_type

Certificate.title: Protocol
Certificate.name: protocol
Certificate.description: Specifies the network protocol used to communicate with the Docker Engine API.
Certificate.tooltip: Select HTTPS for secure TLS-encrypted communication. Use HTTP only when the Docker Engine API is configured without TLS and communication occurs within a trusted network.

Certificate.title: Server Address
Certificate.name: server_address
Certificate.description: Specifies the hostname or IP address of the server running the Docker Engine API.
Certificate.tooltip: Enter the fully qualified hostname or IP address of the Docker Engine server, such as docker.example.com or 192.168.1.100. Do not include the protocol or port in this field.

Certificate.title: Port
Certificate.name: port
Certificate.description: Specifies the TCP port on which the Docker Engine API accepts incoming connections.
Certificate.tooltip: Enter the Docker Engine API port. The standard ports are 2375 for HTTP and 2376 for HTTPS/TLS. Ensure that the selected port is accessible from the FortiSOAR server.

Certificate.title: Certificate Path
Certificate.name: cert_path
Certificate.description: Specifies the absolute file path to the client certificate used to authenticate the connector with the Docker Engine API over TLS.
Certificate.tooltip: Enter the absolute path to the client certificate in PEM format. The certificate must correspond to the private key specified in Key Path.

Certificate.title: Key Path
Certificate.name: key_path
Certificate.description: Specifies the absolute file path to the private key associated with the client certificate used for TLS authentication.
Certificate.tooltip: Enter the absolute path to the client private key in PEM format. Ensure that the key corresponds to the certificate specified in Certificate Path and is readable by the FortiSOAR integration process.

Certificate.title: CA Certificate Path
Certificate.name: ca_cert_path
Certificate.description: Specifies the absolute file path to the Certificate Authority (CA) certificate used to validate the Docker Engine server's TLS certificate.
Certificate.tooltip: Enter the absolute path to the CA certificate in PEM format. The CA certificate must be able to validate the server certificate presented by the Docker Engine.

fields.title: API Version
fields.name: api_version
fields.description: Specifies the Docker Engine API version that the connector uses when sending requests to the Docker server.
fields.tooltip: Enter the API version supported by the target Docker Engine, such as v1.55. Using a compatible API version ensures that the connector can access the required Docker API endpoints and features.

fields.title: Registry Server
fields.name: registry_server
fields.description: Specifies the URL of the container registry used for Docker image-related operations such as pulling and pushing images.
fields.tooltip: Enter the registry server URL. For Docker Hub, the default value is https://index.docker.io/v1/. For a private registry, provide the URL of the applicable registry server.

fields.title: Registry Username
fields.name: registry_username
fields.description: Specifies the username used to authenticate with the configured Docker container registry when performing authenticated image operations.
fields.tooltip: Enter the username of the Docker registry account. Leave this field empty if registry authentication is not required.

fields.title: Registry Password
fields.name: registry_password
fields.description: Specifies the password or access token used together with the registry username to authenticate with the configured Docker container registry.
fields.tooltip: Enter the registry account password or access token. For registries that support access tokens, using a token instead of a password is recommended. Leave this field empty if registry authentication is not required.

fields.title: Request Timeout
fields.name: timeout
fields.description: Specifies the maximum amount of time, in seconds, that the connector waits for a Docker Engine API request to complete before the request is considered timed out.
fields.tooltip: Enter the request timeout in seconds. Increase the value for operations that may take longer to complete, such as image builds, image pulls, or large data transfers.

fields.title: Rate Limit
fields.name: rate_limit
fields.description: Specifies the maximum number of requests that the connector can send to the Docker Engine API within one minute.
fields.tooltip: Enter the maximum number of API requests allowed per minute. Configure this value according to the capacity of the Docker server and the expected connector workload to prevent excessive API traffic.

fields.title: Retry Attempts
fields.name: retry_attempts
fields.description: Specifies the number of additional attempts the connector makes when a Docker Engine API request fails due to a retryable error.
fields.tooltip: Enter the number of times the connector should retry a failed request before returning the error. A higher value can improve reliability for temporary network or service failures but may increase the total request duration.

fields.title: Retry Delay
fields.name: retry_delay
fields.description: Specifies the amount of time, in seconds, that the connector waits between consecutive retry attempts for a failed API request.
fields.tooltip: Enter the delay between retry attempts. Increasing the delay can help when the Docker server or network requires additional time to recover from a temporary failure.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.description: Specifies whether the connector validates the Docker Engine server's TLS/SSL certificate when establishing an HTTPS connection.
fields.tooltip: Enable this option to validate the server certificate against the configured CA certificate. Disable it only when certificate verification is intentionally not required, such as when using a self-signed certificate in a trusted environment.

operations.title: Ping
operations.description: Checks the connectivity and availability of the Docker daemon.

operations.title: Get Version
operations.description: Retrieves version and system information for the Docker environment, including Docker version, API compatibility, operating system, architecture, kernel, build details, and installed components.

operations.title: Get System Information
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about the Docker environment, including containers, images, storage and logging drivers, runtime configuration, system resources, operating system, kernel, networking, security options, registry configuration, and Docker services.

operations.title: System Disk Usage
operations.description: Retrieves disk space usage information for Docker containers, images, volumes, and build cache.

parameters.title: Type
parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Specifies the Docker resource types for which disk usage information is retrieved.
parameters.tooltip: Select the Docker resource type for which disk usage information should be retrieved. Leave this blank to retrieve information for all supported resource types.

parameters.title: Verbose
parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include detailed disk usage information for the selected Docker resources.
parameters.tooltip: Enable this option to include detailed information about disk space usage for the selected resource types.

operations.title: System Events
operations.description: Streams real-time events from the Docker environment, including events related to containers, images, networks, volumes, and other Docker resources.

parameters.title: Filters
parameters.description: Specifies event filters in JSON format to return only events matching the selected criteria, such as resource type, action, or resource identifier. For reference, see: https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version/v1.55/#tag/System/operation/SystemEvents.
parameters.tooltip: Enter JSON-formatted filters to limit events based on criteria such as resource type, action, or resource identifier.
parameters.name: filters

parameters.title: Since
parameters.description: Specifies the timestamp from which events should be retrieved. Events occurring from this time onward are returned, including new events as they occur.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the starting date and time for retrieving events. New matching events are streamed after the specified time.
parameters.name: since

parameters.title: Until
parameters.description: Specifies the timestamp until which events should be retrieved. Event streaming stops after this time is reached.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ending date and time for retrieving events. Streaming stops after the specified time.
parameters.name: until

operations.title: Create Container
operations.description: Creates a new Docker container using the specified image and configuration.

parameters.title: Container Name
parameters.tooltip: Specifies the name to assign to the new container.
parameters.description: Specifies the name to assign to the container. The name must contain only letters, numbers, underscores, periods, and hyphens, and must begin with a letter or number. Must match /?[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+.
parameters.name: name

parameters.title: Image
parameters.tooltip: Specifies the Docker image to use for creating the container, including an optional tag or digest.
parameters.description: Specifies the Docker image to use for creating the container. The image can include a tag or digest to identify a specific image version.
parameters.name: image

parameters.title: Platform
parameters.tooltip: Specifies the target operating system and architecture for the container image, such as linux/amd64 or linux/arm64.
parameters.description: Specifies the target platform for the container image, such as the operating system and architecture.
parameters.name: platform

parameters.title: Host Name
parameters.tooltip: Specifies the hostname assigned to the container.
parameters.description: Specifies the hostname assigned to the container. The hostname should be a valid RFC 1123 hostname.
parameters.name: Hostname

parameters.title: Domain Name
parameters.tooltip: Specifies the domain name assigned to the container.
parameters.description: Specifies the domain name assigned to the container.
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.title: Command
parameters.tooltip: Specifies the command to execute when the container starts.
parameters.description: Specifies the command to run when the container starts. The command can be provided as a string or as an array of command arguments.
parameters.name: Cmd

parameters.title: Host Configuration
parameters.tooltip: Specifies host-level container settings in JSON format, such as resources, ports, volumes, networking, and restart policies.
parameters.description: Specifies host-level configuration for the container in JSON format, such as resource limits, port bindings, volume mounts, networking, restart policies, and other host settings.
parameters.name: HostConfig

parameters.title: Additional Fields
parameters.name: additional_fields
parameters.tooltip: Specify additional container configuration fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.
parameters.description: Specify additional container configuration fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.

operations.title: List Containers
operations.description: Retrieves a list of Docker containers and their configuration, status, networking, storage, and image information.

parameters.title: All
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include all containers, including stopped and exited containers. By default, only running containers are returned.
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include all containers, including stopped, created, and exited containers. When disabled, only running containers are returned.
parameters.name: all

parameters.title: Filters
parameters.tooltip: Enter JSON-formatted filters to return only containers matching the specified criteria.
parameters.description: Specifies filters in JSON format to limit the containers returned based on criteria such as status, name, ID, image, label, or other supported container attributes. For example, {"status": ["paused"]} will only return paused containers. For reference, see: https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version/v1.55/#tag/Container/operation/ContainerList.
parameters.name: filters

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.tooltip: Specifies the maximum number of containers to return, starting with the most recently created containers.
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of containers to return, starting with the most recently created containers.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.title: Size
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include disk usage information for each container.
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include the container's disk usage information, including the writable layer size and total root filesystem size.
parameters.name: size

operations.title: Inspect Container
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about a Docker container, including its configuration, current state, networking, storage, mounts, resource settings, and runtime details.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container to inspect.
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the container to inspect.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Size
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include disk usage information for the container, including its writable layer and root filesystem size.
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include the container's disk usage information, including the size of its writable layer and root filesystem.
parameters.name: size

operations.title: Container Logs
operations.description: Retrieves logs generated by a Docker container, with options to filter the output by time, stream, number of lines, and timestamps.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the container from which you want to retrieve logs.
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the container from which to retrieve logs.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Follow
parameters.tooltip: Enable to continuously receive new log entries while the container generates them.
parameters.description: Keeps the log stream open and continuously returns new log entries as they are generated.
parameters.name: follow

parameters.title: Stdout
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include messages written to the standard output stream.
parameters.description: Includes log messages written to the container's standard output stream.
parameters.name: stdout

parameters.title: Stderr
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include messages written to the standard error stream.
parameters.description: Includes log messages written to the container's standard error stream.
parameters.name: stderr

parameters.title: Since
parameters.tooltip: Specify the starting date and time for the logs to retrieve.
parameters.description: Specifies the date and time from which log entries should be retrieved.
parameters.name: since

parameters.title: Until
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ending date and time for the logs to retrieve.
parameters.description: Specifies the date and time up to which log entries should be retrieved.
parameters.name: until

parameters.title: Timestamps
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include timestamps with each returned log entry.
parameters.description: Includes the timestamp for each log entry in the returned output.
parameters.name: timestamps

parameters.title: Tail
parameters.tooltip: Specify the number of log lines to return from the end. Use all to return all available log lines.
parameters.description: Specifies the number of log lines to return from the end of the log output. Use an integer to limit the number of lines or specify "all" to return all available log lines.
parameters.name: tail

operations.title: Container Statistics
operations.description: Retrieves resource usage and performance statistics for a Docker container, including CPU, memory, network, process, block I/O, and storage information.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the container for which statistics should be retrieved.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container to retrieve its resource usage statistics.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Stream
parameters.description: Specifies whether to continuously stream updated container statistics. When disabled, statistics are retrieved once and the connection is closed.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to continuously receive updated statistics. Disable to retrieve statistics once.
parameters.name: stream

parameters.title: One Shot
parameters.description: Specifies whether to retrieve a single set of statistics without waiting for multiple collection cycles. This option must be used with Stream disabled.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to retrieve a single set of statistics immediately. Use only when Stream is disabled.
parameters.name: oneshot

operations.title: Wait Container
operations.description: Waits for a Docker container to reach the specified condition and returns its exit status.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the container to monitor until it reaches the specified condition.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container to wait for.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Condition
parameters.description: Specifies the container state condition that must be reached before the action returns. Defaults to Not Running when no condition is specified.
parameters.tooltip: Select the container state to wait for: Not Running, Next Exit, or Removed.
parameters.name: condition

operations.title: Rename Container
operations.description: Renames an existing Docker container with the specified name.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or current name of the Docker container to rename.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or current name of the Docker container you want to rename.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: New Name
parameters.description: Specifies the new name to assign to the Docker container.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the new name for the Docker container.
parameters.name: name

operations.title: Update Container
operations.description: Updates the configuration of an existing Docker container without recreating it.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to update.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container you want to update.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Memory
parameters.description: Specifies the memory limit for the container in bytes. Set to 0 to remove the memory limit.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the memory limit in bytes. Use 0 to remove the memory limit.
parameters.name: Memory

parameters.title: CPU Shares
parameters.description: Specifies the relative CPU weight assigned to the container compared with other containers.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the relative CPU weight for the container compared with other containers.
parameters.name: CpuShares

parameters.title: CPU Quota
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum amount of CPU time the container can use during each CPU period, in microseconds.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the CPU time limit per CPU period in microseconds.
parameters.name: CpuQuota

parameters.title: CPU Period
parameters.description: Specifies the duration of each CPU scheduling period in microseconds.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the CPU scheduling period in microseconds.
parameters.name: CpuPeriod

parameters.title: Additional Fields
parameters.description: Specifies additional container configuration fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.
parameters.tooltip: Specify additional container configuration fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.
parameters.name: additional_fields

operations.title: Copy To Container
operations.description: Copies a tar archive to a specified directory in a Docker container and extracts its contents there.

parameters.name: input
parameters.title: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the type of file reference used to provide the archive to Docker.
parameters.tooltip: Select whether the archive is provided using an Attachment ID or a File IRI.

parameters.name: value
parameters.title: Reference ID
parameters.description: Specifies the reference used to access the archive file. For playbook executions, this defaults to the {{vars.attachment_id}} or {{vars.file_iri}} value based on the selected Type.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the Attachment ID or File IRI that references the archive file to copy to the container.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to which the archive is copied.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container where you want to copy the archive.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Path in Container
parameters.description: Specifies the path to the directory in the container where the archive contents are extracted.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the directory path in the container where the archive contents should be extracted.
parameters.name: path

operations.title: Remove Container
operations.description: Removes a Docker container and optionally removes its associated anonymous volumes or link.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to remove.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container you want to remove.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Force
parameters.description: Specifies whether to forcefully remove the container. If enabled, a running container is stopped before it is removed.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to forcefully remove the container, including stopping it if it is currently running.
parameters.name: force

parameters.title: Volumes
parameters.description: Specifies whether to remove anonymous volumes associated with the container.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to remove anonymous volumes associated with the container.
parameters.name: v

parameters.title: Link
parameters.description: Specifies whether to remove the specified link associated with the container.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to remove the specified link associated with the container.
parameters.name: link

operations.title: Prune Containers
operations.description: Removes unused Docker containers based on the specified filters.

parameters.title: Filters
parameters.description: Specifies filters in JSON format to determine which unused containers should be removed.
parameters.tooltip: Enter JSON-formatted filters to limit which unused containers are removed. Leave this blank to remove all eligible unused containers.
parameters.name: filters

operations.title: Start Container
operations.description: Starts a stopped Docker container.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to start.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container you want to start.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Detach Keys
parameters.description: Specifies the key sequence used to detach from the container when an interactive session is attached.
parameters.tooltip: Enter a custom key sequence to detach from an interactive container session. Leave this blank to use the default sequence.
parameters.name: detachKeys

operations.title: Stop Container
operations.description: Stops a running Docker container gracefully, with an optional timeout before it is forcibly terminated.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to stop.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container you want to stop.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Signal
parameters.description: Specifies the signal to send to the container when stopping it. The signal can be provided as an integer or a signal name, such as SIGINT.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the signal to send to the container, such as SIGINT. Leave this blank to use the default signal.
parameters.name: signal

parameters.title: Timeout (seconds)
parameters.description: Specifies the number of seconds to wait for the container to stop gracefully before it is forcibly terminated.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the number of seconds to wait for the container to stop gracefully before it is forcibly terminated.
parameters.name: t

operations.title: Restart Container
operations.description: Restarts a Docker container, with an optional timeout for gracefully stopping it before it is forcibly terminated.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to restart.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container you want to restart.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Signal
parameters.description: Specifies the signal to send to the container when stopping it as part of the restart operation. The signal can be provided as an integer or a signal name, such as SIGINT.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the signal to send to the container when stopping it during the restart. Leave this blank to use the default signal.
parameters.name: signal

parameters.title: Timeout
parameters.description: Specifies the number of seconds to wait for the container to stop gracefully before it is forcibly terminated and restarted.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the number of seconds to wait for the container to stop gracefully before it is forcibly terminated and restarted.
parameters.name: t

operations.title: Kill Container
operations.description: Forcefully stops a Docker container by sending the specified signal.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to stop.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container you want to stop.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Signal
parameters.description: Specifies the signal to send to the container. The signal can be provided as an integer or a signal name, such as SIGINT. Defaults to SIGKILL.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the signal to send to the container, such as SIGKILL or SIGINT. Defaults to SIGKILL.
parameters.name: signal

operations.title: Pause Container
operations.description: Pauses all processes running inside a Docker container.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to pause.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container you want to pause.
parameters.name: id

operations.title: Unpause Container
operations.description: Resumes all processes in a paused Docker container.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to resume.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the paused Docker container you want to resume.
parameters.name: id

operations.title: Exec in Container
operations.description: Runs a command inside a running Docker container with the specified execution and input/output settings.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the running Docker container in which the command should be executed.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the running Docker container where you want to execute the command.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Command
parameters.description: Specifies the command to execute inside the container. The command can be provided as a string or as an array of command arguments.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the command to execute inside the container.
parameters.name: Cmd

parameters.title: User
parameters.description: Specifies the user and, optionally, the group under which the command should run inside the container. Supported formats include user, user:group, uid, and uid:gid.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the user or user and group for running the command, such as root or 1000:1000.
parameters.name: User

parameters.title: Working Directory
parameters.description: Specifies the working directory in the container for the command execution.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the working directory in the container where the command should be executed.
parameters.name: WorkingDir

parameters.title: Privileged
parameters.description: Specifies whether to run the command with extended privileges inside the container.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to run the command with extended privileges inside the container.
parameters.name: Privileged

parameters.title: Attach Standard Input
parameters.description: Specifies whether to attach the command's standard input stream.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to attach standard input to the command.
parameters.name: AttachStdin

parameters.title: Attach Standard Output
parameters.description: Specifies whether to attach the command's standard output stream.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to attach standard output and receive the command's output.
parameters.name: AttachStdout

parameters.title: Attach Standard Error
parameters.description: Specifies whether to attach the command's standard error stream.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to attach standard error and receive error output from the command.
parameters.name: AttachStderr

parameters.title: Detach
parameters.description: Specifies whether to detach from the command after it starts running.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to detach from the command and allow it to continue running independently.
parameters.name: Detach

parameters.title: Tty
parameters.description: Specifies whether to allocate a pseudo-terminal (TTY) for the command.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to allocate a pseudo-terminal for the command. This is useful for interactive commands.
parameters.name: Tty

parameters.title: Additional Fields
parameters.description: Specifies additional execution configuration fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.
parameters.tooltip: Specify additional execution configuration fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.
parameters.name: additional_fields

operations.title: Attach Container
operations.description: Attaches to a Docker container to read its output or provide input through the selected streams.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to attach to.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container you want to attach to.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Stdin
parameters.description: Specifies whether to attach to the container's standard input stream.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to send input to the container through the standard input stream.
parameters.name: stdin

parameters.title: Stdout
parameters.description: Specifies whether to attach to the container's standard output stream.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to receive output from the container's standard output stream.
parameters.name: stdout

parameters.title: Stderr
parameters.description: Specifies whether to attach to the container's standard error stream.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to receive error output from the container's standard error stream.
parameters.name: stderr

parameters.title: Stream
parameters.description: Specifies whether to continuously stream output generated by the attached container after the action starts.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to continuously receive new output from the container as it is generated.
parameters.name: stream

parameters.title: Logs
parameters.description: Specifies whether to replay previously generated container logs before receiving new output. When Stream is enabled, the action continues streaming current output after the previous logs are returned.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to retrieve previous container logs before streaming current output.
parameters.name: logs

parameters.title: Detach Keys
parameters.description: Specifies a custom key sequence used to detach from the container session.
parameters.tooltip: Enter a custom key sequence to detach from the container session. Leave this blank to use the default sequence.
parameters.name: detachKeys

operations.title: Resize Container TTY
operations.description: Resizes the TTY session of a Docker container to the specified height and width.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container whose TTY session should be resized.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container whose TTY session you want to resize.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Height
parameters.description: Specifies the height of the TTY session in characters.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the height of the TTY session in characters.
parameters.name: h

parameters.title: Width
parameters.description: Specifies the width of the TTY session in characters.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the width of the TTY session in characters.
parameters.name: w

operations.title: Copy From Container
operations.description: Copies a file or directory from a Docker container and stores it as a tar archive.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container from which the resource should be copied.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container from which you want to copy a file or directory.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Path
parameters.description: Specifies the path to the file or directory in the container's filesystem to copy.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the path to the file or directory in the container that you want to copy.
parameters.name: path

operations.title: Export Container
operations.description: Exports the filesystem contents of a Docker container as a tar archive.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to export.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container whose filesystem contents you want to export.
parameters.name: id

operations.title: Commit Container
operations.description: Creates a new Docker image from the current state of a container.

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container from which the image should be created.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container you want to commit as an image.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Repository
parameters.description: Specifies the repository name for the newly created Docker image.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the repository name to assign to the created image.
parameters.name: repo

parameters.title: Tag
parameters.description: Specifies the tag to assign to the newly created Docker image. Defaults to latest.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the tag for the created image. Defaults to latest.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.title: Comment
parameters.description: Specifies a descriptive comment or commit message for the created image.
parameters.tooltip: Enter an optional comment describing the changes or purpose of the created image.
parameters.name: comment

parameters.title: Author
parameters.description: Specifies the author information to associate with the created image.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the author information to associate with the created image.
parameters.name: author

parameters.title: Changes
parameters.description: Specifies Dockerfile instructions to apply to the container configuration when creating the image.
parameters.tooltip: Enter Dockerfile instructions to apply when creating the image, such as CMD, ENTRYPOINT, ENV, or EXPOSE.
parameters.name: changes

parameters.title: Pause
parameters.description: Specifies whether to pause the container during the commit operation to prevent changes while the image is being created.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to pause the container while creating the image. Defaults to enabled.
parameters.name: pause

parameters.title: Additional Fields
parameters.name: additional_fields
parameters.tooltip: Specify additional image creation fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.
parameters.description: Specifies additional image creation fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.

operations.title: Build Image
operations.description: Builds a Docker image from the specified Dockerfile content and build configuration.

parameters.title: Docker File Content
parameters.description: Specifies the contents of the Dockerfile used to build the image.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the Dockerfile instructions used to build the Docker image.
parameters.name: dockerfile_content

parameters.title: Tag
parameters.description: Specifies the name and optional tag to assign to the built image in the name:tag format. If no tag is specified, latest is used.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the image name and optional tag, such as my-image:1.0. The tag defaults to latest if omitted.
parameters.name: t

parameters.title: No Cache
parameters.description: Specifies whether to disable the build cache and rebuild all applicable image layers.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to build the image without using cached layers.
parameters.name: nocache

parameters.title: Pull Base Images
parameters.description: Specifies whether to attempt to pull newer versions of the base images before building the image.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to pull the latest available base images before the build, even if a local version exists.
parameters.name: pull

parameters.title: Build Args
parameters.description: Specifies build-time variables as a JSON map of key-value pairs. These values can be used by Dockerfile instructions for variable expansion or during build commands.
parameters.tooltip: Enter build-time variables in JSON format, such as {"FOO":"bar"}. Do not use this field to pass sensitive or secret values.
parameters.name: buildargs

parameters.title: Labels
parameters.description: Specifies custom metadata labels to apply to the built image as a JSON map of key-value pairs.
parameters.tooltip: Enter image labels in JSON format, such as {"environment":"production"}.
parameters.name: labels

parameters.title: Network Mode
parameters.description: Specifies the network mode used by build commands that require network access, such as bridge, host, none, container:<name|id>, or a custom network name or ID.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the network mode to use during the build, such as bridge, host, or none.
parameters.name: networkmode

parameters.title: Platform
parameters.description: Specifies the target platform for the image in the os[/arch[/variant]] format.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the target platform, such as linux/amd64 or linux/arm64.
parameters.name: platform

parameters.title: Additional Fields
parameters.name: additional_fields
parameters.tooltip: Specify additional image build fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.
parameters.description: Specifies additional image build fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.

operations.title: Pull Image
operations.description: Pulls a Docker image from a registry or imports an image from the specified source.

parameters.title: Image
parameters.description: Specifies the image name to pull. The image name can include an optional tag or digest to identify a specific image version.
parameters.name: fromImage
parameters.tooltip: Enter the image name to pull, with an optional tag or digest, such as library/nginx:latest.

parameters.title: From Source
parameters.description: Specifies the source from which an image should be imported. The value can be a URL or - to read the image from the request body. This parameter is used only when importing an image.
parameters.name: fromSrc
parameters.tooltip: Enter the source URL for the image to import, or - to read the image from the request body.

parameters.title: Repository Name
parameters.description: Specifies the repository name to assign to an imported image. The repository name can include a tag. This parameter is used only when importing an image.
parameters.name: repo
parameters.tooltip: Enter the repository name to assign to the imported image, optionally including a tag.

parameters.title: Tag
parameters.description: Specifies the tag or digest of the image to pull. If no tag or digest is specified, all available tags for the specified image are pulled.
parameters.name: tag
parameters.tooltip: Enter the image tag or digest to pull. Leave this blank to pull all available tags.

parameters.title: Message
parameters.description: Specifies the commit message to associate with an imported image.
parameters.name: message
parameters.tooltip: Enter an optional commit message for the imported image.

parameters.title: Additional Fields
parameters.name: additional_fields
parameters.tooltip: Specify additional image pull or import fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.
parameters.description: Specifies additional image pull or import fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.

operations.title: List Images
operations.description: Retrieves a list of Docker images available on the Docker host, including image IDs, tags, sizes, labels, digests, and other summary information.

parameters.title: All
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include all images, including intermediate images that are not referenced by a child image. When disabled, only final-layer images are returned.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include all images, including intermediate images. By default, only final-layer images are returned.
parameters.name: all

parameters.title: Filters
parameters.description: Specifies filters in JSON format to limit the images returned based on supported image attributes.
parameters.tooltip: Enter JSON-formatted filters to return only images matching the specified criteria.
parameters.name: filters

parameters.title: Shared Size
parameters.description: Specifies whether to calculate and include the amount of storage shared with other images for each returned image.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include the shared storage size for each image.
parameters.name: shared_size

parameters.title: Digests
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include repository digest information for each returned image.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include repository digest information for each image.
parameters.name: digests

parameters.title: Manifests
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include manifest information in the image summary.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include manifest information for each image.
parameters.name: manifests

parameters.title: Identity
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include identity information in each manifest summary. This option requires Manifests to be enabled.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include identity information in manifest summaries. Enable Manifests to use this option.
parameters.name: identity

operations.title: Search Images
operations.description: Searches Docker Hub for images matching the specified search term and returns image details such as name, description, popularity, and official or automated status.

parameters.title: Search Term
parameters.description: Specifies the term used to search for images on Docker Hub.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the image name or search term to find matching images on Docker Hub.
parameters.name: term

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of image search results to return.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the maximum number of images to return. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.title: Filters
parameters.description: Specifies filters in JSON format to limit the image search results based on supported image attributes.
parameters.tooltip: Enter JSON-formatted filters to return only images matching the specified criteria.
parameters.name: filters

operations.title: Inspect Image
operations.description: Retrieves detailed, low-level information about a Docker image, including its configuration, metadata, filesystem layers, platform, tags, and digests.

parameters.title: Image Name or ID
parameters.description: Specifies the name or ID of the Docker image to inspect.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the name or ID of the Docker image you want to inspect.
parameters.name: name

parameters.title: Manifests
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include manifest information in the image inspection results.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include manifest details for the inspected image.
parameters.name: manifests

operations.title: Image History
operations.description: Retrieves the layer history of a Docker image, including layer IDs, sizes, tags, creation details, and commands used to create each layer.

parameters.title: Image Name or ID
parameters.description: Specifies the name or ID of the Docker image for which the layer history should be retrieved.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the name or ID of the Docker image whose layer history you want to view.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Platform
parameters.description: Specifies the OCI platform variant to use when retrieving the image history in JSON format. If omitted, Docker selects an available platform, prioritizing the host platform.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the OCI platform in JSON format, such as {"os":"linux","architecture":"arm","variant":"v5"}. Leave blank to use the default available platform.
parameters.name: platform

operations.title: Tag Image
operations.description: Creates an additional tag reference for a Docker image, optionally using a different repository name and tag.

parameters.title: Image Name or ID
parameters.description: Specifies the name or ID of the Docker image to tag.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the name or ID of the Docker image you want to tag.
parameters.name: name

parameters.title: Repository
parameters.description: Specifies the repository name for the new image tag, such as someuser/someimage.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the repository name to associate with the new tag, such as someuser/someimage.
parameters.name: repo

parameters.title: Tag
parameters.description: Specifies the tag name to assign to the image in the specified repository.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the tag name to assign to the image, such as latest or v1.0.
parameters.name: tag

operations.title: Push Image
operations.description: Pushes a Docker image from the local image store to a container registry.

parameters.title: Image Name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the Docker image to push. The image must exist in the local image store with the specified name.
parameters.name: name
parameters.tooltip: Enter the image name without a tag, such as registry.example.com/myimage. If a tag is included, it is ignored and should instead be provided in the Tag field.

parameters.title: Tag
parameters.description: Specifies the tag of the image to push. If no tag is provided, all tags of the specified image available in the local image store are pushed.
parameters.name: tag
parameters.tooltip: Enter the image tag to push, such as latest. Leave blank to push all available tags for the specified image.

parameters.title: Platform
parameters.description: Specifies the OCI platform variant to push in JSON format. If omitted, all available platform variants are attempted.
parameters.name: platform
parameters.tooltip: Enter the OCI platform in JSON format, such as {"os":"linux","architecture":"arm","variant":"v5"}. Leave blank to attempt pushing all available platform variants.

operations.title: Remove Image
operations.description: Removes a Docker image from the local image store and optionally removes its untagged parent images.

parameters.title: Image Name or ID
parameters.description: Specifies the name or ID of the Docker image to remove.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the name or ID of the Docker image you want to remove.
parameters.name: name

parameters.title: Force
parameters.description: Specifies whether to force removal of the image, including when it is referenced by stopped containers or has multiple tags.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to forcefully remove the image even if it is referenced by stopped containers or has other tags.
parameters.name: force

parameters.title: No Prune
parameters.description: Specifies whether to preserve untagged parent images that would otherwise be removed as part of the image removal.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to keep untagged parent images instead of removing them.
parameters.name: noprune

operations.title: Prune Images
operations.description: Removes unused Docker images from the local image store based on the specified filters.

parameters.title: Filters
parameters.description: Specifies filters in JSON format to determine which unused images should be removed.
parameters.tooltip: Enter JSON-formatted filters to limit which unused images are removed. Leave this blank to remove all eligible unused images.
parameters.name: filters

operations.title: Create Network
operations.description: Creates a Docker network with the specified driver, scope, connectivity, and IP configuration.

parameters.title: Name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the Docker network to create.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the name to assign to the new Docker network.
parameters.name: Name

parameters.title: Driver
parameters.description: Specifies the network driver to use for the new Docker network. Defaults to bridge.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the network driver to use, such as bridge, host, or overlay. Defaults to bridge.
parameters.name: Driver

parameters.title: Scope
parameters.description: Specifies the scope of the network, such as local for a single Docker host or swarm for a cluster-wide network.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the network scope, such as local or swarm.
parameters.name: Scope

parameters.title: Internal
parameters.description: Specifies whether to restrict the network from accessing external networks.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to restrict external connectivity for containers connected to this network.
parameters.name: Internal

parameters.title: Attachable
parameters.description: Specifies whether manually created containers can connect to a swarm-scoped network.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to allow regular containers to manually attach to a swarm-scoped network.
parameters.name: Attachable

parameters.title: Ingress
parameters.description: Specifies whether the network is used as the ingress network for routing traffic in Docker Swarm mode.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to create the network as an ingress network for Docker Swarm routing.
parameters.name: Ingress

parameters.title: Enable IPv4
parameters.description: Specifies whether IPv4 networking is enabled on the Docker network.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to allow IPv4 networking on the new Docker network.
parameters.name: EnableIPv4

parameters.title: Enable IPv6
parameters.description: Specifies whether IPv6 networking is enabled on the Docker network.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to allow IPv6 networking on the new Docker network.
parameters.name: EnableIPv6

parameters.title: Additional Fields
parameters.name: additional_fields
parameters.tooltip: Specify additional network configuration fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.
parameters.description: Specifies additional network configuration fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.

operations.title: List Networks
operations.description: Retrieves a list of Docker networks and their configuration, including drivers, scopes, IPAM settings, labels, and connectivity options.

parameters.title: Filters
parameters.description: Specifies filters in JSON format to limit the networks returned based on supported network attributes.
parameters.tooltip: Enter JSON-formatted filters to return only networks matching the specified criteria. Leave this blank to return all networks.
parameters.name: filters

operations.title: Inspect Network
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about a Docker network, including its configuration, IPAM settings, connected containers, and network options.

parameters.title: Network ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker network to inspect.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker network you want to inspect.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Verbose
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include additional network information for troubleshooting and diagnostic purposes.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to include additional network details that can help with troubleshooting.
parameters.name: verbose

parameters.title: Scope
parameters.description: Specifies the network scope to use when inspecting the network, such as local, swarm, or global.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the network scope to inspect, such as local, swarm, or global. Leave blank to use the default scope.
parameters.name: scope

operations.title: Connect Network
operations.description: Connects a Docker container to a network. The network must be local-scoped or a swarm-scoped network configured as attachable.

parameters.title: Network ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker network to connect to the container.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker network you want to connect to the container.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to connect to the network.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container you want to connect to the network.
parameters.name: Container

parameters.title: Additional Fields
parameters.name: additional_fields
parameters.tooltip: Specify additional network connection fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.
parameters.description: Specifies additional network connection fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.

operations.title: Disconnect Network
operations.description: Disconnects a Docker container from a network.

parameters.title: Network ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker network from which the container should be disconnected.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker network you want to disconnect the container from.
parameters.name: id

parameters.title: Container ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker container to disconnect from the network.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker container you want to disconnect from the network.
parameters.name: Container

parameters.title: Force
parameters.description: Specifies whether to force the container to disconnect from the network.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to forcefully disconnect the container from the network.
parameters.name: Force

operations.title: Remove Network
operations.description: Removes a Docker network from the Docker host.

parameters.title: Network ID or Name
parameters.description: Specifies the ID or name of the Docker network to remove.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID or name of the Docker network you want to remove.
parameters.name: id

operations.title: Prune Networks
operations.description: Removes unused Docker networks from the Docker host based on the specified filters.

parameters.title: Filters
parameters.description: Specifies filters in JSON format to determine which unused Docker networks should be removed.
parameters.tooltip: Enter JSON-formatted filters to limit which unused networks are removed. Leave this blank to remove all eligible unused networks.
parameters.name: filters

operations.title: Create Volume
operations.description: Creates a Docker volume using the specified name, driver, and configuration.

parameters.title: Name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the Docker volume to create. Docker generates a name when a name is not provided.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the name for the new Docker volume.
parameters.name: Name

parameters.title: Driver
parameters.description: Specifies the volume driver to use for the new Docker volume. Defaults to local.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the volume driver to use, such as local. Defaults to local.
parameters.name: Driver

parameters.title: Additional Fields
parameters.name: additional_fields
parameters.tooltip: Specify additional volume configuration fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.
parameters.description: Specifies additional volume configuration fields in JSON format that are not available through the other parameters.

operations.title: List Volumes
operations.description: Retrieves a list of Docker volumes and their configuration, including names, drivers, scopes, labels, options, and mount points.

parameters.title: Filters
parameters.description: Specifies filters in JSON format to limit the Docker volumes returned based on supported volume attributes.
parameters.tooltip: Enter JSON-formatted filters to return only volumes matching the specified criteria. Leave this blank to return all volumes.
parameters.name: filters

operations.title: Inspect Volume
operations.description: Inspect a volume

parameters.title: Volume Name
parameters.description: Volume name or ID
parameters.name: name

operations.title: Remove Volume
operations.description: Removes a Docker volume from the Docker host.

parameters.title: Volume Name
parameters.description: Specifies the name or identifier of the Docker volume to remove.
parameters.tooltip: Enter the name or identifier of the Docker volume you want to remove.
parameters.name: name

parameters.title: Force
parameters.description: Specifies whether to force the removal of the Docker volume.
parameters.tooltip: Enable to forcefully remove the Docker volume.
parameters.name: force

operations.title: Prune Volumes
operations.description: Removes unused Docker volumes from the Docker host based on the specified filters.

parameters.title: Filters
parameters.description: Specifies filters in JSON format to determine which unused Docker volumes should be removed.
parameters.tooltip: Enter JSON-formatted filters to limit which unused volumes are removed. Leave this blank to remove all eligible unused volumes.
parameters.name: filters
